reason: Integrates the upstream WPS Office MCP service into DeepSeek Harness and exposes its document automation tools, including operations that can modify real WPS documents.

summaries.zh: 将上游 WPS Office MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，并通过命名空间工具提供 WPS 文档自动化能力。
summaries.en: Connects the upstream WPS Office MCP service to DeepSeek Harness and exposes namespaced tools for WPS document automation.

capabilities: Starts the upstream wps-office-mcp service as a trusted local subprocess
Exposes WPS Office MCP tools through DeepSeek Harness
Enables reading and modifying WPS documents through upstream tools
Provides read-only environment diagnostics for Node, DSH, WPS MCP, and WPS add-in status
